key_actions: Implemented accounts/api_keys/usage_events schema for BrocaAPI starter (Postgres).
Added API-key auth (x-api-key) and usage logging to /session, /memory/upsert, /memory/query, /actuator/request, /actuator/approve.
Created admin_init script to bootstrap default account and API key.
Updated starter_kit README and quickstart docs with monetization/auth flow.
Dockerized and smoke-tested starter_kit via docker compose (BrocaAPI starter running at :8080).
Identified remaining auth bug: Pydantic type mismatch (UUID -> str) in get_auth_context; to be fixed next session.
Discussed and queued cost-reduction work (caching, rate limits) for next session.
session_continuity.next_session_notes: First fix get_auth_context to cast UUIDs to strings in AuthContext; re-run E2E smoke test (session/memory/admin_usage). Then design and implement cost reduction: embeddings/LLM caching in BrocaOS, optional query caching and simple rate limits for starter_kit.
